'''Rashan''' is a [[Warder]].

==History==
He and [[Bartol]] are bonded to [[Erian Boroleos]].

He is possibly [[Domani]], given that there is another character in the series named Rashan who appears in [[Graendal]]'s palace in Arad Doman.

==Activities==
Erian reports to [[Galina Casban]] that Rashan and Bartol are suffering from her other Warders' deaths worse than she is. She comforts them in their grief.

Although Erian Travels to [[Far Madding]] with [[Cadsuane]], she is forced to leave Rashan behind.

Erian feels Rashan and Bartol [[Travel]] suddenly from [[Cairhien]] in steps towards where she is staying in [[Tear]]. They are Travelling with [[Logain Ablar]] and [[Toveine Gazal]], who are using the Warder bond to locate their Aes Sedai so that Logain may contact the [[Dragon Reborn]].
